sentences.text: The United States Coast Pilot, published by NOAA, supplements the chart with information that can’t be drawn on it: navigation regulations, local hazards, anchorages, bridge and cable clearances, currents, weather, and descriptions of ports and channels.
Coast Pilot four covers the Atlantic coast from Cape Henry, Virginia, to Key West, and Coast Pilot five covers the Gulf coast, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands.
Read the relevant chapters before you run a new inlet or harbor.
It’s free to download and updated regularly.
